# Quizzy Architecture & Design Notes

## Overview
Quizzy is a Rails 8.1 application (SQLite + Propshaft + Hotwire/Stimulus + Action Cable) for running live conference talk quizzes.

## Runtime & Deployment (`bin/serve`)
- Started via `bin/serve` with `RAILS_ENV=production`, `PORT`, `SECRET_KEY_BASE`, `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME`, `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD`.
- Plain HTTP (`assume_ssl = false`, `force_ssl = false`), accepts any `Host` header (`config.hosts.clear`) and any WebSocket `Origin` (`config.action_cable.disable_request_forgery_protection = true`), serves static assets directly from Puma (`public_file_server.enabled = true`).
- Health check at `GET /up` (unauthenticated, returns `200`).
- All SQLite databases reside under `storage/`.

## Domain Model
### Quiz Preparation
- `Quiz` (`quizzes`): `title` (required), `number_of_winners` (integer >= 1, default `3`). `has_many :questions` ordered by `(position, id)`, `has_many :active_questions`, `has_many :games`.
- `Question` (`questions`): `quiz_id`, `body` (required), `active` (boolean, default `true`), `position` (1-indexed integer). `has_many :options` ordered by `(position, id)`.
  - `save_with_option_rows(question_attrs, raw_rows)`: skips blank option rows, validates `>= 2` non-empty options (`"Add at least two options"`) and `>= 1` correct option among non-empty rows (`"Mark at least one option as correct"`).
  - `move_up!` / `move_down!`: swaps adjacent siblings inside `quiz.with_lock` and compacts positions `1..n`.
- `Option` (`options`): `question_id`, `text` (required), `correct` (boolean, default `false`), `position` (1-indexed integer). Multiple correct options per question are supported.

### Live Game, Scoring & Prizes
- `Game` (`games`): `quiz_id`, `number_of_winners` (snapshotted from quiz), unique 5-char uppercase `code` (e.g. `K7RZX`), `status` (`lobby` -> `question_open` <-> `question_closed` -> `finished`), `current_question_index`, monotonic `state_version`, `base_url`, timestamps (`started_at`, `question_opened_at`, `question_closed_at`, `finished_at`).
  - `start!` snapshots `@quiz.number_of_winners` and `@quiz.active_questions` (skipping inactive questions) and their `options` into `GameQuestion` (`game_questions`, including per-question `opened_at`) and `GameOption` (`game_options`), isolating the running/completed game from future quiz edits while keeping optional `question_id` / `option_id` references (`on_delete: :nullify`).
  - Inline SVG QR code is generated locally via `rqrcode` (`Game#qr_svg`) encoding the exact `join_url` displayed on the lobby screen.
- `Player` (`players`): `game_id`, `name` (required), `token` (unique), `browser_token` (unique per `game_id`, persisted in permanent signed cookies), `connections_count`, `online_until`, `winner` (boolean, default `false`).
- `GameAnswer` (`game_answers`): unique per `(game_question_id, player_id)`, pointing to `game_option_id`, `client_seq`, `answered_at`, and `response_time_us` (elapsed microseconds from when that `GameQuestion` opened to the player's last accepted pick).
- **Scoring & Leaderboard (`Game#leaderboard_records`)**:
  - 1 point per correct `GameAnswer` (`game_option.correct == true`).
  - Ranked by `[ -points, correct_time_us, player.id ]`: equal points are broken by lower total `response_time_us` across correct answers only.
  - Points and places are hidden from players throughout `lobby`, `question_open`, and `question_closed`, and revealed only once `status == "finished"`.
- **Winner Selection (`N = game.number_of_winners`)**:
  - Players with `0` points never win; if fewer than `N` players have `points > 0`, all players with `points > 0` win.
  - `pick_top_winners!` (`"Top N"`): selects the first `N` eligible players on the leaderboard.
  - `draw_winners!` (`"Draw"`): when more than `N` players have `points > 0`, every player strictly above the `N`-th place's points wins automatically, and the remaining `N - guaranteed.size` prizes are sampled uniformly at random among players with exactly the `N`-th place's points (ignoring speed). Each click redraws from scratch.
  - `reset_winners!` (`"Reset winners"`): clears `winner` on all players.

## Real-Time Channels & Security
- Single-process Puma uses Action Cable's in-memory `async` adapter so `broadcast_all!` pushes questions, closes, leaderboards, and winner changes to the big screen and all audience phones within milliseconds.
- `ModerateGameChannel`: authenticates via HMAC-signed `stream_token` (`Rails.application.message_verifier(:moderate_game)`).
- `PlayGameChannel`: streams public game state (`play_game_<code>`) and player-specific answer confirmations and finished place/points/winner states (`play_player_<token>`).

My focus has been on designing a robust and user-friendly timer for Quizzy, ensuring it functions correctly across all scenarios, especially with validation and edge cases. The rationale behind having separate "Timer minutes" and "Timer seconds" fields is purely for user interface design, mirroring the standard M:SS format. Critically, validating `timer_seconds` to be less than 60 (`less_than: 60` or `less_than_or_equal_to: 59`) is crucial for data integrity and user expectations.

Validation must handle diverse inputs, like empty strings (invalid, except in cases like 'Number of winners' where `allow_blank: true` exists) and negative values. The presence of `novalidate: true` in the form suggests a bypass of browser HTML5 validation, which enables robust server-side error handling for inputs like `timer_seconds=60`.

The timer's integration with the `Game` model involves "snapshotting" the timer setting from the `Quiz` to the `Game` at the game's start. Specifically, a `time_limit_seconds` attribute is added to the `Game` model, mirroring the duration calculations from the `Quiz`. A new helper `timer_enabled?` is added to clearly check the state of the timer. If time limit is `0`, then the game proceeds without a timer.

To ensure accurate time management, the implementation employs a multi-layered approach. The critical aspect is to ensure reliable timer expiration, even if the moderator's browser is closed, or has lost connection, or tests are run with a travel-to or system time. First, a server-side timer check (`expire_timer_if_due!`) runs whenever we read or mutate the game state, which guarantees a consistent state. Second, we integrate a background timer thread (`Concurrent::ScheduledTask`) that executes and runs in a performant way, and which handles all edge cases.

Client-side countdown is implemented with precision by calculating remaining time using server timestamps, rendering it as `"M:SS"` with `ceil(remaining_ms / 1000)` to present "1:30" or "0:05" at question opening. This is essential to show accurate countdown from the very start. The use of `performance.now()` and remaining server-side milliseconds guarantees consistent rendering, taking into account any clock skew between server and client. The page reloads seamlessly continue the countdown down to `"0:00"`. Auto-finish at `0:00` is designed to be deterministic, with both server-side checks and client-side actions to transition the game state even if the moderator's screen is closed or has lost connection. The use of an idempotent `PATCH /finish` request ensures that questions are not finished multiple times, with an optional `question_id` to prevent inadvertent finish actions on an earlier or subsequent question.

Finally, the UI design places the timer prominently within the moderator's big screen and excludes players from seeing it. The design choice centers around visual clarity on the big screen, with the timer placed inside the question stage to reinforce a visual connection. The styling ensures the countdown displays with high contrast and without text jitter.

      )
    end

    result
  end

  def bump_version_and_broadcast_moderator!
    with_lock do
      update_columns(state_version: state_version + 1, updated_at: Time.current)
    end
    broadcast_moderator!
  end

  def leaderboard_records
    loaded_players = players.order(:id).to_a
    return [] if loaded_players.empty?

    correct_stats = GameAnswer
      .joins(:game_question, :game_option)
      .where(game_questions: { game_id: id }, game_options: { correct: true })
      .group(:player_id)
      .pluck(:player_id, Arel.sql("COUNT(*)"), Arel.sql("COALESCE(SUM(game_answers.response_time_us), 0)"))
      .each_with_object({}) do |(player_id, count, total_us), acc|
        acc[player_id] = { points: count.to_i, correct_time_us: total_us.to_i }
      end

    sorted = loaded_players.map do |player|
      stats = correct_stats[player.id] || { points: 0, correct_time_us: 0 }
      {
        player: player,
        points: stats[:points],
        correct_time_us: stats[:correct_time_us]
      }
    end.sort_by { |entry| [ -entry[:points], entry[:correct_time_us], entry[:player].id ] }

    total = sorted.size
    sorted.each_with_index.map do |entry, idx|
      entry.merge(
        place: idx + 1,
        total_players: total
      )
    end
  end

  def moderator_payload(fallback_base_url: nil)
    reload_online_ids = online_player_ids
    online_count = reload_online_ids.size

    payload = {
      version: state_version,
      id: id,
      code: code,
      status: status,
      quiz_title: quiz.title,
      join_url: join_url(fallback_base_url),
      active_players_count: online_count,
      number_of_winners: number_of_winners
    }

    if question_open? || question_closed?
      gq = current_game_question
      if gq
        total = game_questions.count
        opts = gq.game_options.to_a

        if question_open?
          answered_count = reload_online_ids.empty? ? 0 : gq.game_answers.where(player_id: reload_online_ids).count
          payload[:question] = {
            id: gq.id,
            position: gq.position,
            total: total,
            last_question: gq.position == total,
            body: gq.body,
            answered_count: answered_count,
            options: opts.map { |opt| { id: opt.id, text: opt.text } }
          }
        else
          counts_by_option = gq.game_answers.group(:game_option_id).count
          total_answers = counts_by_option.values.sum
          payload[:question] = {
            id: gq.id,
            position: gq.position,
            total: total,
            last_question: gq.position == total,
            body: gq.body,
            total_answers: total_answers,
            options: opts.map do |opt|
              {
                id: opt.id,
                text: opt.text,
                correct: opt.correct?,
                answers_count: counts_by_option.fetch(opt.id, 0)
              }
            end
          }
        end
      end
    elsif finished?
      payload[:leaderboard] = leaderboard_records.map do |entry|
        pts = entry[:points]
        {
          id: entry[:player].id,
          place: entry[:place],
          name: entry[:player].name,
          points: pts,
          points_label: self.class.points_label(pts),
          winner: entry[:player].winner?
        }
      end
    end

    payload
  end

  def play_broadcast_payload
    payload = {
      type: "game_state",
      version: state_version,
      code: code,
      quiz_title: quiz.title,
      status: status
    }

    if question_open? || question_closed?
      gq = current_game_question
      if gq
        total = game_questions.count
        payload[:question] = {
          id: gq.id,
          position: gq.position,
          total: total,
          body: gq.body,
          options: gq.game_options.to_a.map do |opt|
            item = { id: opt.id, text: opt.text }
            item[:correct] = opt.correct? if question_closed?
            item
          end
        }
"

class GameTimerScheduler
  @mutex = Mutex.new
  @tasks = {}

  class << self
    def schedule(game_id:, question_id:, run_at:)
      token = Object.new
      delay = [ run_at.to_f - Time.current.to_f, 0.0 ].max

      task = Concurrent::ScheduledTask.new(delay) do
        run_expiration(game_id: game_id, question_id: question_id, run_at: run_at, token: token)
      end

      old_entry = nil
      @mutex.synchronize do
        old_entry = @tasks[game_id]
        @tasks[game_id] = { token: token, task: task }
      end
      old_entry[:task].cancel if old_entry

      task.execute
      task
    end

    def cancel(game_id)
      entry = @mutex.synchronize { @tasks.delete(game_id) }
      entry[:task].cancel if entry
    end

    def cancel_all!
      entries = @mutex.synchronize do
        current = @tasks.values
        @tasks.clear
        current
      end
      entries.each { |entry| entry[:task].cancel }
    end

    private

    def run_expiration(game_id:, question_id:, run_at:, token:)
      active = @mutex.synchronize { @tasks[game_id]&.dig(:token).equal?(token) }
      return unless active

      Rails.application.executor.wrap do
        remaining = run_at.to_f - Time.current.to_f
        if remaining > 0.001
          reschedule(game_id: game_id, question_id: question_id, run_at: run_at, token: token, delay: remaining + 0.005)
          return
        end

        still_active = @mutex.synchronize do
          if @tasks[game_id]&.dig(:token).equal?(token)
            @tasks.delete(game_id)
            true
          else
            false
          end
        end
        return unless still_active

        game = Game.find_by(id: game_id)
        game&.expire_timer_if_due!(question_id: question_id)
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      Rails.logger.error("GameTimerScheduler error for game=#{game_id}: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
    end

    def reschedule(game_id:, question_id:, run_at:, token:, delay:)
      next_task = Concurrent::ScheduledTask.new(delay) do
        run_expiration(game_id: game_id, question_id: question_id, run_at: run_at, token: token)
      end

      replaced = @mutex.synchronize do
        if @tasks[game_id]&.dig(:token).equal?(token)
          @tasks[game_id] = { token: token, task: next_task }
          true
        else
          false
        end
      end

      if replaced
        next_task.execute
      else
        next_task.cancel
      end
    end
  end
end

class Game < ApplicationRecord

  before_validation :assign_number_of_winners, on: :create
  before_validation :assign_time_limit_seconds, on: :create
  after_destroy :cancel_timer_schedule

  validates :code, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :status, inclusion: { in: STATUSES }
  validates :number_of_winners, numericality: { only_integer: true, greater_than_or_equal_to: 1 }
  validates :time_limit_seconds, numericality: { only_integer: true, greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }

  def self.points_label(points)
    "#{points} #{points == 1 ? 'point' : 'points'}"
  end

  def self.format_timer_ms(ms)
    clamped_ms = [ ms.to_i, 0 ].max
    total_seconds = (clamped_ms + 999) / 1000
    minutes = total_seconds / 60
    seconds = total_seconds % 60
    format("%d:%02d", minutes, seconds)
  end

  def lobby?
    status == "lobby"
  end

  def question_open?
    status == "question_open"
  end

  def question_closed?
    status == "question_closed"
  end

  def finished?
    status == "finished"
  end

  def timer_enabled?
    time_limit_seconds.to_i > 0
  end

  def question_deadline_at(gq = nil)
    return nil unless question_open? && timer_enabled?

    opened = gq&.opened_at || question_opened_at
    return nil unless opened

    opened + time_limit_seconds.seconds
  end

  def timer_remaining_ms(gq = nil, now: Time.current)
    return nil unless question_open? && timer_enabled?

    deadline = question_deadline_at(gq)
    return time_limit_seconds * 1000 if deadline.nil?

    raw_ms = ((deadline.to_r - now.to_r) * 1000).round
    raw_ms.clamp(0, time_limit_seconds * 1000)
  end

  def current_game_question
    return nil if lobby? || finished?

    game_questions.includes(:game_options).find_by(position: current_question_index + 1)
  end

  def online_player_ids
    players.currently_online.pluck(:id)
  end

  def active_players_count
    players.currently_online.count
  end

  def join_url(fallback_base_url = nil)
    effective_base = fallback_base_url.presence || base_url.presence || "http://localhost:3000"
    "#{effective_base.sub(%r{/\z}, '')}/play/#{code}"
  end

  def qr_svg(fallback_base_url = nil)
    qrcode = RQRCode::QRCode.new(join_url(fallback_base_url))
    qrcode.as_svg(
      color: "000000",
      fill: "ffffff",
      shape_rendering: "crispEdges",
      module_size: 8,
      offset: 16,
      standalone: true,
      use_path: true,
      viewbox: true,
      svg_attributes: {
        role: "img",
        "aria-label" => "QR code"
      }
    ).sub(/\A<\?xml[^?]*\?>\s*/, "").html_safe
  end

  def stream_token
    Rails.application.message_verifier(:moderate_game).generate(id)
  end

  def self.find_by_stream_token(token)
    game_id = Rails.application.message_verifier(:moderate_game).verified(token)
    find_by(id: game_id) if game_id.present?
  end

  def start!
    changed = false
    scheduled_question_id = nil
    scheduled_deadline = nil

    with_lock do
      next unless lobby?

      quiz_record = Quiz.find(quiz_id)
      winners_n = quiz_record.number_of_winners
      time_limit = quiz_record.timer_duration_seconds
      active_qs = quiz_record.active_questions.includes(:options).to_a
      now = Time.current

      if active_qs.empty?
        update!(
          status: "finished",
          number_of_winners: winners_n,
          time_limit_seconds: time_limit,
          started_at: now,
          finished_at: now,
          state_version: state_version + 1
        )
      else
        first_gq = nil
        active_qs.each_with_index do |q, q_idx|
          gq = game_questions.create!(
            question_id: q.id,
            body: q.body,
            position: q_idx + 1,
            opened_at: q_idx == 0 ? now : nil
          )
          first_gq = gq if q_idx == 0
          q.options.each_with_index do |opt, o_idx|
            gq.game_options.create!(
              option_id: opt.id,
              text: opt.text,
              correct: opt.correct?,
              position: o_idx + 1
            )
          end
        end

        update!(
          status: "question_open",
          number_of_winners: winners_n,
          time_limit_seconds: time_limit,
          current_question_index: 0,
          started_at: now,
          question_opened_at: now,
          question_closed_at: nil,
          state_version: state_version + 1
        )

        if time_limit > 0 && first_gq
          scheduled_question_id = first_gq.id
          scheduled_deadline = now + time_limit.seconds
        end
      end
      changed = true
    end

    if changed
      if scheduled_question_id && scheduled_deadline
        GameTimerScheduler.schedule(game_id: id, question_id: scheduled_question_id, run_at: scheduled_deadline)
      end
      broadcast_all!
    end
    changed
  end

  def finish_question!(question_id: nil)
    changed = false
    with_lock do
      next unless question_open?

      if question_id.present?
        gq = current_game_question
        next if gq.nil? || gq.id != question_id.to_i
      end

      update!(
        status: "question_closed",
        question_closed_at: Time.current,
        state_version: state_version + 1
      )
      changed = true
    end

    if changed
      GameTimerScheduler.cancel(id)
      broadcast_all!
    end
    changed
  end

  def expire_timer_if_due!(question_id: nil)
    return false unless question_open? && timer_enabled?

    changed = false
    with_lock do
      next unless question_open? && timer_enabled?

      gq = current_game_question
      if question_id.present?
        next if gq.nil? || gq.id != question_id.to_i
      end

      deadline = question_deadline_at(gq)
      next if deadline.nil? || Time.current < deadline

      update!(
        status: "question_closed",
        question_closed_at: Time.current,
        state_version: state_version + 1
      )
      changed = true
    end

    if changed
      GameTimerScheduler.cancel(id)
      broadcast_all!
    end
    changed
  end

  def next_question!
    changed = false
    scheduled_question_id = nil
    scheduled_deadline = nil

    with_lock do
      next unless question_closed?

      next_index = current_question_index + 1
      next_gq = game_questions.find_by(position: next_index + 1)
      next if next_gq.nil?

      now = Time.current
      next_gq.update!(opened_at: now)
      update!(
        status: "question_open",
        current_question_index: next_index,
        question_opened_at: now,
        question_closed_at: nil,
        state_version: state_version + 1
      )

      if timer_enabled?
        scheduled_question_id = next_gq.id
        scheduled_deadline = now + time_limit_seconds.seconds
      end
      changed = true
    end

    if changed
      if scheduled_question_id && scheduled_deadline
        GameTimerScheduler.schedule(game_id: id, question_id: scheduled_question_id, run_at: scheduled_deadline)
      end
      broadcast_all!
    end
    changed
  end

  def end_quiz!
    changed = false
    with_lock do
      next if finished?

      players.where(winner: true).update_all(winner: false)
      update!(
        status: "finished",
        finished_at: Time.current,
        state_version: state_version + 1
      )
      changed = true
    end

    if changed
      GameTimerScheduler.cancel(id)
      broadcast_all!
    end
    changed
  end

  def pick_top_winners!
    changed = false
    with_lock do
      next unless finished?

      eligible = leaderboard_records.select { |entry| entry[:points] > 0 }
      winner_ids = eligible.first(number_of_winners).map { |entry| entry[:player].id }

      players.update_all(winner: false)
      players.where(id: winner_ids).update_all(winner: true) if winner_ids.any?
      update_columns(state_version: state_version + 1, updated_at: Time.current)
      changed = true
    end

    broadcast_all! if changed
    changed
  end

  def draw_winners!(random: SecureRandom)
    changed = false
    with_lock do
      next unless finished?

      records = leaderboard_records
      eligible = records.select { |entry| entry[:points] > 0 }

      winner_ids =
        if eligible.size <= number_of_winners
          eligible.map { |entry| entry[:player].id }
        else
          cutoff_points = records[number_of_winners - 1][:points]
          guaranteed = eligible.select { |entry| entry[:points] > cutoff_points }
          remaining = number_of_winners - guaranteed.size
          tied_pool = eligible.select { |entry| entry[:points] == cutoff_points }
          drawn = tied_pool.sample(remaining, random: random)
          (guaranteed + drawn).map { |entry| entry[:player].id }
        end

      players.update_all(winner: false)
      players.where(id: winner_ids).update_all(winner: true) if winner_ids.any?
      update_columns(state_version: state_version + 1, updated_at: Time.current)
      changed = true
    end

    broadcast_all! if changed
    changed
  end

  def reset_winners!
    changed = false
    with_lock do
      next unless finished?

      players.where(winner: true).update_all(winner: false)
      update_columns(state_version: state_version + 1, updated_at: Time.current)
      changed = true
    end

    broadcast_all! if changed
    changed
  end

  def submit_answer!(player:, option_id:, client_seq: 0)
    result = nil
    gq = nil
    expired_now = false

    with_lock do
      if !question_open? || player.nil? || player.game_id != id
        result = { accepted: false }
        next
      end

      gq = current_game_question
      if gq.nil?
        result = { accepted: false }
        next
      end

      now = Time.current
      if timer_enabled?
        deadline = question_deadline_at(gq)
        if deadline && now >= deadline
          update!(
            status: "question_closed",
            question_closed_at: now,
            state_version: state_version + 1
          )
          expired_now = true
          result = { accepted: false }
          next
        end
      end

      option = gq.game_options.find { |o| o.id == option_id.to_i }
      if option.nil?
        result = { accepted: false }
        next
      end

      answer = gq.game_answers.find_or_initialize_by(player_id: player.id)
      seq = client_seq.to_i

      if answer.persisted? && seq > 0 && answer.client_seq > 0 && seq < answer.client_seq
        result = { accepted: true, question_id: gq.id, picked_option_id: answer.game_option_id }
        next
      end

      opened_at = gq.opened_at || question_opened_at || now
      elapsed_us = ((now.to_r - opened_at.to_r) * 1_000_000).round
      elapsed_us = 0 if elapsed_us < 0

      answer.game_option_id = option.id
      answer.client_seq = [ seq, answer.client_seq.to_i ].max
      answer.answered_at = now
      answer.response_time_us = elapsed_us
      answer.save!

      update_columns(state_version: state_version + 1, updated_at: now)
      result = { accepted: true, question_id: gq.id, picked_option_id: option.id }
    end

    if expired_now
      GameTimerScheduler.cancel(id)
      broadcast_all!
      return result
    end

    if result[:accepted]
      broadcast_moderator!
      ActionCable.server.broadcast(
        "play_player_#{player.token}",
        {
          type: "player_answer",
          version: state_version,
          question_id: result[:question_id],
          picked_option_id: result[:picked_option_id]
        }
      )
    end

    result
  end

  def bump_version_and_broadcast_moderator!
    with_lock do
      update_columns(state_version: state_version + 1, updated_at: Time.current)
    end
    broadcast_moderator!
  end

  def leaderboard_records
    loaded_players = players.order(:id).to_a
    return [] if loaded_players.empty?

    correct_stats = GameAnswer
      .joins(:game_question, :game_option)
      .where(game_questions: { game_id: id }, game_options: { correct: true })
      .group(:player_id)
      .pluck(:player_id, Arel.sql("COUNT(*)"), Arel.sql("COALESCE(SUM(game_answers.response_time_us), 0)"))
      .each_with_object({}) do |(player_id, count, total_us), acc|
        acc[player_id] = { points: count.to_i, correct_time_us: total_us.to_i }
      end

    sorted = loaded_players.map do |player|
      stats = correct_stats[player.id] || { points: 0, correct_time_us: 0 }
      {
        player: player,
        points: stats[:points],
        correct_time_us: stats[:correct_time_us]
      }
    end.sort_by { |entry| [ -entry[:points], entry[:correct_time_us], entry[:player].id ] }

    total = sorted.size
    sorted.each_with_index.map do |entry, idx|
      entry.merge(
        place: idx + 1,
        total_players: total
      )
    end
  end

  def moderator_payload(fallback_base_url: nil)
    reload_online_ids = online_player_ids
    online_count = reload_online_ids.size

    payload = {
      version: state_version,
      id: id,
      code: code,
      status: status,
      quiz_title: quiz.title,
      join_url: join_url(fallback_base_url),
      active_players_count: online_count,
      number_of_winners: number_of_winners
    }

    if question_open? || question_closed?
      gq = current_game_question
      if gq
        total = game_questions.count
        opts = gq.game_options.to_a

        if question_open?
          answered_count = reload_online_ids.empty? ? 0 : gq.game_answers.where(player_id: reload_online_ids).count
          question_payload = {
            id: gq.id,
            position: gq.position,
            total: total,
            last_question: gq.position == total,
            body: gq.body,
            answered_count: answered_count,
            options: opts.map { |opt| { id: opt.id, text: opt.text } }
          }
          if timer_enabled?
            rem_ms = timer_remaining_ms(gq)
            question_payload[:timer_remaining_ms] = rem_ms
            question_payload[:timer_display] = self.class.format_timer_ms(rem_ms)
          end
          payload[:question] = question_payload
        else
          counts_by_option = gq.game_answers.group(:game_option_id).count
          total_answers = counts_by_option.values.sum
          payload[:question] = {
            id: gq.id,
            position: gq.position,
            total: total,
            last_question: gq.position == total,
            body: gq.body,
            total_answers: total_answers,
            options: opts.map do |opt|
              {
                id: opt.id,
                text: opt.text,
                correct: opt.correct?,
                answers_count: counts_by_option.fetch(opt.id, 0)
              }
            end
          }
        end
      end
    elsif finished?
      payload[:leaderboard] = leaderboard_records.map do |entry|
        pts = entry[:points]
        {
          id: entry[:player].id,
          place: entry[:place],
          name: entry[:player].name,
          points: pts,
          points_label: self.class.points_label(pts),
          winner: entry[:player].winner?
        }
      end
    end

    payload
  end

  def play_broadcast_payload
    payload = {
      type: "game_state",
      version: state_version,
      code: code,
      quiz_title: quiz.title,
      status: status
    }

    if question_open? || question_closed?
      gq = current_game_question
      if gq
        total = game_questions.count
        payload[:question] = {
          id: gq.id,
          position: gq.position,
          total: total,
          body: gq.body,
          options: gq.game_options.to_a.map do |opt|
            item = { id: opt.id, text: opt.text }
            item[:correct] = opt.correct? if question_closed?
            item
          end
        }
      end
    end

    payload
  end

  def player_state_payload(player, precomputed_records: nil)
    base = play_broadcast_payload.except(:type)

    if player.present? && player.game_id == id
      base[:joined] = true
      base[:player_name] = player.name
      base[:player_token] = player.token

      if base[:question].present?
        picked_id = GameAnswer.where(game_question_id: base[:question][:id], player_id: player.id).pick(:game_option_id)
        base[:question] = base[:question].merge(picked_option_id: picked_id)
      elsif finished?
        records = precomputed_records || leaderboard_records
        my_entry = records.find { |r| r[:player].id == player.id }
        if my_entry
          pts = my_entry[:points]
          base[:result] = {
            place: my_entry[:place],
            total_players: my_entry[:total_players],
            points: pts,
            place_label: "Place #{my_entry[:place]} of #{my_entry[:total_players]}",
            points_label: self.class.points_label(pts),
            winner: my_entry[:player].winner?
          }
        end
      end
    else
      base[:joined] = false
      base.delete(:question) unless finished?
    end

    base
  end

  def broadcast_moderator!
    ActionCable.server.broadcast("moderate_game_#{id}", moderator_payload)
  end

  def broadcast_players!
    ActionCable.server.broadcast("play_game_#{code}", play_broadcast_payload)

    return unless finished?

    records = leaderboard_records
    records.each do |entry|
      player = entry[:player]
      ActionCable.server.broadcast(
        "play_player_#{player.token}",
        player_state_payload(player, precomputed_records: records).merge(type: "player_sync")
      )
    end
  end

  def broadcast_all!
    broadcast_players!
    broadcast_moderator!
  end

  private

  def assign_unique_code
    return if code.present?

    loop do
      candidate = Array.new(CODE_LENGTH) { CODE_ALPHABET.sample }.join
      unless self.class.exists?(code: candidate)
        self.code = candidate
        break
      end
    end
  end

  def assign_number_of_winners
    if quiz && !will_save_change_to_number_of_winners?
      self.number_of_winners = quiz.number_of_winners
    end
  end

  def assign_time_limit_seconds
    if quiz && !will_save_change_to_time_limit_seconds?
      self.time_limit_seconds = quiz.timer_duration_seconds
    end
  end

  def cancel_timer_schedule
    GameTimerScheduler.cancel(id)
  end
end

cat <<'EOF' > docs/architecture.md
# Quizzy Architecture & Design Notes

## Overview
Quizzy is a Rails 8.1 application (SQLite + Propshaft + Hotwire/Stimulus + Action Cable) for running live conference talk quizzes.

## Runtime & Deployment (`bin/serve`)
- Started via `bin/serve` with `RAILS_ENV=production`, `PORT`, `SECRET_KEY_BASE`, `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME`, `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD`.
- Plain HTTP (`assume_ssl = false`, `force_ssl = false`), accepts any `Host` header (`config.hosts.clear`) and any WebSocket `Origin` (`config.action_cable.disable_request_forgery_protection = true`), serves static assets directly from Puma (`public_file_server.enabled = true`).
- Health check at `GET /up` (unauthenticated, returns `200`).
- All SQLite databases reside under `storage/`.

## Domain Model
### Quiz Preparation
- `Quiz` (`quizzes`): `title` (required), `number_of_winners` (integer >= 1, default `3`), `timer_minutes` (integer >= 0, default `0`), `timer_seconds` (integer `0..59`, default `0`). `has_many :questions` ordered by `(position, id)`, `has_many :active_questions`, `has_many :games`.
  - `timer_duration_seconds` = `timer_minutes * 60 + timer_seconds` (`0` means no timer).
- `Question` (`questions`): `quiz_id`, `body` (required), `active` (boolean, default `true`), `position` (1-indexed integer). `has_many :options` ordered by `(position, id)`.
  - `save_with_option_rows(question_attrs, raw_rows)`: skips blank option rows, validates `>= 2` non-empty options (`"Add at least two options"`) and `>= 1` correct option among non-empty rows (`"Mark at least one option as correct"`).
  - `move_up!` / `move_down!`: swaps adjacent siblings inside `quiz.with_lock` and compacts positions `1..n`.
- `Option` (`options`): `question_id`, `text` (required), `correct` (boolean, default `false`), `position` (1-indexed integer). Multiple correct options per question are supported.

### Live Game, Timer, Scoring & Prizes
- `Game` (`games`): `quiz_id`, `number_of_winners` (snapshotted from quiz), `time_limit_seconds` (snapshotted from `quiz.timer_duration_seconds`), unique 5-char uppercase `code` (e.g. `K7RZX`), `status` (`lobby` -> `question_open` <-> `question_closed` -> `finished`), `current_question_index`, monotonic `state_version`, `base_url`, timestamps (`started_at`, `question_opened_at`, `question_closed_at`, `finished_at`).
  - `start!` snapshots `@quiz.number_of_winners`, `@quiz.timer_duration_seconds`, and `@quiz.active_questions` (skipping inactive questions) and their `options` into `GameQuestion` (`game_questions`, including per-question `opened_at`) and `GameOption` (`game_options`), isolating the running/completed game from future quiz edits while keeping optional `question_id` / `option_id` references (`on_delete: :nullify`).
  - **Per-Question Timer (`time_limit_seconds > 0`)**:
    - Each open question's deadline is `gq.opened_at + time_limit_seconds.seconds`. Reloading the moderator screen recomputes `timer_remaining_ms` from `opened_at` so the countdown never restarts.
    - Shown only on the moderator's big screen (`.stage-timer`) in `M:SS` format (`1:30`, `0:05`, etc.) while `status == "question_open"`; omitted from all player HTML, JSON, and Action Cable payloads.
    - Auto-finishes at `0:00` via `GameTimerScheduler` (in-process `Concurrent::ScheduledTask` calling `Game#expire_timer_if_due!` and broadcasting to moderator and players, re-hydrated on boot in `config/initializers/live_games.rb`), backed up by lazy expiration checks on HTTP/WebSocket reads and answer submissions (`submit_answer!` rejects answers at/after deadline) plus an idempotent `question_id`-guarded client fallback.
    - The moderator can still click `"Finish"` earlier (`Game#finish_question!` cancels the scheduled task).
  - Inline SVG QR code is generated locally via `rqrcode` (`Game#qr_svg`) encoding the exact `join_url` displayed on the lobby screen.
- `Player` (`players`): `game_id`, `name` (required), `token` (unique), `browser_token` (unique per `game_id`, persisted in permanent signed cookies), `connections_count`, `online_until`, `winner` (boolean, default `false`).
- `GameAnswer` (`game_answers`): unique per `(game_question_id, player_id)`, pointing to `game_option_id`, `client_seq`, `answered_at`, and `response_time_us` (elapsed microseconds from when that `GameQuestion` opened to the player's last accepted pick).
- **Scoring & Leaderboard (`Game#leaderboard_records`)**:
  - 1 point per correct `GameAnswer` (`game_option.correct == true`).
  - Ranked by `[ -points, correct_time_us, player.id ]`: equal points are broken by lower total `response_time_us` across correct answers only.
  - Points and places are hidden from players throughout `lobby`, `question_open`, and `question_closed`, and revealed only once `status == "finished"`.
- **Winner Selection (`N = game.number_of_winners`)**:
  - Players with `0` points never win; if fewer than `N` players have `points > 0`, all players with `points > 0` win.
  - `pick_top_winners!` (`"Top N"`): selects the first `N` eligible players on the leaderboard.
  - `draw_winners!` (`"Draw"`): when more than `N` players have `points > 0`, every player strictly above the `N`-th place's points wins automatically, and the remaining `N - guaranteed.size` prizes are sampled uniformly at random among players with exactly the `N`-th place's points (ignoring speed). Each click redraws from scratch.
  - `reset_winners!` (`"Reset winners"`): clears `winner` on all players.

## Real-Time Channels & Security
- Single-process Puma uses Action Cable's in-memory `async` adapter so `broadcast_all!` pushes questions, timer expirations, closes, leaderboards, and winner changes to the big screen and all audience phones within milliseconds.
- `ModerateGameChannel`: authenticates via HMAC-signed `stream_token` (`Rails.application.message_verifier(:moderate_game)`).
- `PlayGameChannel`: streams public game state (`play_game_<code>`) and player-specific answer confirmations and finished place/points/winner states (`play_player_<token>`).
- **Answer & timer secrecy invariants**: While `status == "question_open"`, neither HTML source, JSON state endpoints, nor WebSocket broadcasts include option `correct` flags; player endpoints/channels never include timer fields.

## Moderator Area (`/moderate`)
- All controllers under `Moderate::` inherit from `Moderate::BaseController`, enforcing HTTP Basic Authentication against `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME` and `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD` using constant-time comparison (`ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare`).

## Quiz Export & Import
- **Export** (`GET /moderate/quizzes/:id/export` -> `Quiz#export_payload` / `Quiz#to_export_json`): writes **only** `title` and `questions` (`text`, `active`, `options` -> `text`, `correct`). Instance-level settings (`number_of_winners`, `timer_minutes`, `timer_seconds`) are excluded from the export format.
- **Import** (`GET/POST /moderate/quizzes/import` -> `Quiz::Import`): validates and atomically creates a new `Quiz`.
EOF

We have implemented the per-question timer feature for Quizzy:

- **Quiz Settings (`"Timer minutes"` and `"Timer seconds"`)**: Added integer fields defaulting to `0` on `Quiz` (`timer_minutes >= 0`, `timer_seconds` in `0..59`), exposed in the quiz creation and settings form (`app/views/moderate/quizzes/_form.html.erb`). `0` minutes and `0` seconds disables the timer.
- **Export Exclusion**: Kept `Quiz#export_payload` / `Quiz#to_export_json` free of timer settings so exported JSON contains only `title` and `questions`.
- **Big Screen Countdown & Player Secrecy**: Snapshotted `time_limit_seconds` onto `Game` when starting, displaying the `M:SS` countdown (`.stage-timer`, e.g. `"1:30"`, `"0:05"`) on the moderator's big screen only while a question is open (`question_open`), while excluding timer data from all player views, JSON endpoints, and Action Cable channels.
- **Reload Persistence & Auto-Finish at `0:00`**: Computed remaining time from each `GameQuestion`'s `opened_at` timestamp so reloading never restarts the countdown, and added `GameTimerScheduler` + `Game#expire_timer_if_due!` (plus late-answer rejection and an idempotent `question_id`-guarded client fallback) so open questions automatically finish at `0:00` just like clicking `"Finish"`, while still allowing the moderator to click `"Finish"` earlier.
